title: Optimal Sensor Placement for Wastewater Network Monitoring
description: Compiled team review of where to place a small number of sensors in a gravity sewer so that growth from new housing can be seen early. It covers sensor technologies, placement and optimisation methods, sewer condition and failure factors, and the openly available South Australian network data, then applies the review to the Walkerville placement model. On that uncalibrated public-data model, one level sensor sees every Design-wet growth run and five see 94% of runs on average across seven wet cases, while float switches alone reach no more than 35% at any budget.
